egress_lt_enabled_lane.description: When link training is enabled on lane <lane>, the procedure selected by EgressLTProtocolLane<lane> is executed. 0: link training not enabled on the lane, 1: link training enabled on the lane.

egress_lt_protocol_lane.description: Link training protocol/procedure used when link training is enabled on egress lane <lane>.

egress_lt_retries_lane.description: Maximum number of retries after which the controlling link training entity terminates the session on egress lane <lane>.

egress_lt_timeout_lane.description: Maximum duration after which the controlling link training entity times out and terminates the session on egress lane <lane>.

host_out_ffe_cursor_location.description: FFE cursor location L of HostOut lane <lane>, encoded as L = [register] + 1.

host_out_ffe_length.description: FFE length N of HostOut lane <lane>, encoded as N = [register] + 1.

host_out_invoke_load_preset_flag.description: Preset configuration change request per lane: 0: no preset configuration change on lane <lane>, 1: preset configuration change on lane <lane>; requested preset in HostOut<lane>PresetRequested. M2H message bit, clear on read.

host_out_invoke_load_preset_mask.description: Mask bits for the HostOut<lane>InvokeLoadPresetFlag (page 50h byte 241). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

host_out_invoke_set_pattern_flag.description: Pattern configuration change request per lane: 0: no pattern configuration change for lane <lane>, 1: pattern configuration change for lane <lane>; requested pattern in HostOut<lane>PatternRequested. M2H message bit, clear on read.

host_out_invoke_set_pattern_mask.description: Mask bits for the HostOut<lane>InvokeSetPatternFlag (page 50h byte 240). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

host_out_invoke_set_precoder_flag.description: Precoder configuration change request per lane: 0: no precoder configuration change for lane <lane>, 1: precoder configuration change for lane <lane>; requested setting in HostOut<lane>PrecoderConfigured. M2H message bit, clear on read.

host_out_invoke_set_precoder_mask.description: Mask bits for the HostOut<lane>InvokeSetPrecoderFlag (page 50h byte 242). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

host_out_invoke_set_sqm_alarm_thr_mask.description: Mask bits for the corresponding SQM alarm threshold procedure invocation Flag; no matching Flag register is recorded in the parsed OIF-CMIS-LT-01.0 map (see namespace README). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

host_out_invoke_set_sqm_target_mask.description: Mask bits for the corresponding SQM target procedure invocation Flag; no matching Flag register is recorded in the parsed OIF-CMIS-LT-01.0 map (see namespace README). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

host_out_invoke_tuning_mask.description: Mask bits for the HostOut<lane>InvokeTuningFlag (page 51h byte 226). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

host_out_out_tuning_step.description: Nominal p-p differential amplitude step size for HostOut lane <lane>; reported amplitude values have only 50 mV resolution.

host_out_pattern_configured.description: Configured pattern of HostOut on lane <lane> after the last change; maintained by the host responder.

host_out_pattern_requested.description: (Desired) pattern for HostOut on lane <lane>, written by the module's requester engine.

host_out_pattern_setting_completed_trig.description: The host notifies the module about completion of a pattern configuration procedure (with or without success). The module clears the bits fetched and optionally compares actual and requested configuration. H2M message bit, self-clearing.

host_out_precoder_configured.description: Actual precoder configuration status maintained by the host: 0: precoder off, 1: precoder on. The host must keep this register current with the actual precoder configuration.

host_out_precoder_requested.description: 0: precoder off for lane <lane>, 1: precoder on for lane <lane>. The precoder is of type 1/(1+D) mod 4 as defined in IEEE 802.3 clause 135.5.7.2.

host_out_precoder_setting_completed_trig.description: The host notifies the module about completion of a precoder configuration procedure (with or without success). H2M message bit, self-clearing.

host_out_preset_configured.description: Identifier of the actual HostOut preset loaded on lane <lane> in response to a request.

host_out_preset_requested.description: Requested preset configuration for HostOut lane <lane>; the host does not return failure when a preset is not supported.

host_out_preset_setting_completed_trig.description: The host notifies the module about completion of a preset configuration procedure (with or without success). H2M message bit, self-clearing.

host_out_tap_tuning_step.description: HostOut transmit FFE tap tuning step size; reported tap values have only 0.01 resolution.

host_out_training_done_mask.description: Mask bits for the HostOut<lane>TrainingDoneFlag (page 51h byte 228). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

host_out_training_result.description: Link training diagnostic failure code for HostOut lane <lane>; reset to 00b when a new link training is started.

host_out_training_status.description: Status of link training on HostOut lane <lane>, reported by the module per egress lane.

mod_hsin_sqm_alarm_mask.description: Mask bits for the ModHsIn<lane>SqmAlarmFlag (page 51h byte 229). 1 (default): interrupt generation disabled, 0: interrupt generation enabled (unmasked).

mod_hsin_sqm_alarm_threshold.description: SQM degraded alarm threshold for ModHsIn receive lane <lane>.

mod_hsin_target_sqm.description: Target SQM for ModHsIn receive lane <lane>; a U8 value of s encodes the SQM value 10 + s/10, i.e. the unit step size is 0.1.

reserved_249_255.description: Reserved bytes 249-255 (Table 29 lists 249-251 as Reserved, Table 8 lists 252-255 as Reserved; the parsed Table 29 row for 249-251 carries an unexplained WO/SC Adv. type marking, which is not recorded as a field here).

reserved_host_out_ffe_cursor_bits_7_3.description: Reserved bits 7-3 of the HostOut FfeCursorLocation byte (same parsed-table gap as the FfeLength byte).

reserved_host_out_ffe_length_bits_7_3.description: Reserved bits 7-3 of the HostOut FfeLength byte. The parsed table lists bits 7-4 as reserved next to the 2-0 field, leaving bit 3 unassigned; reserved is modeled as bits 7-3.
